mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking.booking (id, tracking_number, transport_request_number, quotation_no, quotation_id, shipper_company_id, status, transport_phase, current_version_no, version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{trackingNumber}, #{transportRequestNumber}, #{quotationNo}, #{quotationId}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{status}, #{transportPhase}, #{currentVersionNo}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO booking.booking_version (booking_id, booking_version_no, transport_request_id, transport_request_version_no, quotation_id, routing_case_number, route_version_no, consignee_company_id, cargo_category, cargo_summary, shipper_approver_id, confirmed_by, committed_at) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{bookingVersionNo}, #{transportRequestId}, #{transportRequestVersionNo}, #{quotationId}, #{routingCaseNumber}, #{routeVersionNo}, #{consigneeCompanyId}, #{cargoCategory}, #{cargoSummary}, #{shipperApproverId}, #{confirmedBy}, #{committedAt})
INSERT INTO booking.processed_command (command_id, command_type, payload_hash, result_ref, processed_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{commandType}, #{payloadHash}, #{resultRef}, #{processedAt})

INSERT INTO booking.booking_saga (id, booking_id, tracking_number, status, current_step, started_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookingId}, #{trackingNumber}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{startedAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tracking_number, transport_request_number, quotation_no, quotation_id, shipper_company_id, status, transport_phase, current_version_no, version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by FROM booking.booking WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}

SELECT booking_id, booking_version_no, transport_request_id, transport_request_version_no, quotation_id, routing_case_number, route_version_no, consignee_company_id, cargo_category, cargo_summary, shipper_approver_id, confirmed_by, committed_at FROM booking.booking_version WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY booking_version_no
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM booking.booking WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
SELECT command_id, command_type, payload_hash, result_ref, processed_at FROM booking.processed_command WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND command_type = 'ConfirmBooking'
